import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

from shapes import Circle, Rectangle

for shape in (Circle(1), Circle(0), Rectangle(3, 4), Rectangle(0, 0), Rectangle(2.5, 0.1)):
    print(shape.describe())
    print(shape.describe(unit="ft"))


class Square(Rectangle):
    name = "square"

    def __init__(self, side):
        super().__init__(side, side)


print(Square(2).describe("cm"))
print("ok")
